scenarios.capability: Classify a docker.io/bitnamilegacy/* image as stale, flag the urgency (no patches coming), and recommend a per-workload escape (Docker Official, Chainguard, CloudNativePG)
instructions_covered: Classify `docker.io/bitnamilegacy/*` as `stale` tier with an urgency flag — the legacy archive receives no patches post-September-2025.
Per-source-family escape recommendations should name the actual replacement for the workload, not a generic 'Docker Official' pointer.

scenarios.capability: Classify a registry.access.redhat.com/ubi9/* image as free-with-caveats (not free, not commercial); cite the Red Hat supported-software-list caveat; recommend Rocky/Alma escape for users wanting full freedom
instructions_covered: Classify RHEL UBI as `free-with-caveats`, not `free` or `commercial`. UBI is free to redistribute but tied to Red Hat's supported-software list.
Per-source-family escape recommendations should name the actual replacement for the workload.
Walk the detection chain in strict order (cosign-attestation first when an SBOM is attached).

scenarios.capability: Distinguish cgr.dev/chainguard/* (free) from cgr.dev/chainguard-private/* (commercial) — must not collapse them into a single vendor verdict
instructions_covered: Tier classification is non-collapsible. Free Chainguard public images and paid Chainguard private images are distinct tiers — do not collapse to a vendor verdict.
Per-source-family escape recommendations should name the actual replacement for the workload.

scenarios.capability: Handle distroless and FROM scratch images gracefully: record signal distroless-or-scratch, tier n/a, escape no-escape-needed; do not crash
instructions_covered: Distroless and FROM scratch images are not detection failures. Record signal `distroless-or-scratch`, classify tier as `n/a`, mark escape `no-escape-needed`. Do not crash on missing /etc/os-release.

scenarios.capability: Emit the full graph for a chart with images spanning all 4 license tiers; sort report so commercial + stale entries appear at the top
instructions_covered: Report sorting: commercial and stale entries at the top of image-graph.md, then free-with-caveats, then free.
Emit two artifacts: image-graph.json (structured graph) AND image-graph.md (human report).
Tier classification is non-collapsible across all 4 tiers.

coverage_notes: Five scenarios, one per license tier plus a multi-image integration test. The trickiest distinction (chainguard-vs-paid-tier) gets a dedicated scenario since collapsing free and paid Chainguard into a single 'Chainguard' verdict is the most plausible failure mode of an unprimed model. The Bitnami scenario tests the post-September-2025 headline (the urgency flag is the load-bearing teaching). The distroless-scratch scenario tests that the skill doesn't crash on the no-OS-layer fallback path.
